description: Analytical data model (formerly 'Power BI dataset') that defines tables, relationships, measures, and calculations. Queried via DAX. Direct Lake mode reads Delta tables directly from OneLake (zero-copy); Import mode loads data into memory. Reports bind to semantic models for visualization.

definition.note: Use --definition <folder> for a complete model folder. --file supplies one model file; fabio generates definition.pbism automatically.

definition_requirements_scope: The definition_parts and definition_requirements below apply only to definition-backed creation and definition updates, not empty or API-native --one-lake-table creation.

definition_parts.description: Required entry point only when supplying a definition; fabio generates it for --file. Not required for empty or --one-lake-table creation. MS schema requires $schema + version. fabio sends {"$schema":".../semanticModel/definitionProperties/1.0.0/schema.json","version":"4.0"} for TMDL and version "3.0" for model.bim; Fabric normalizes the stored version (e.g. to 4.2).
TMDL: one file per table with columns/measures/partitions
Import: full tabular model JSON (compatibilityLevel 1604, powerBI_V3)

flags.--file: Path to a single model.bim (TMSL) or one .tmdl file
flags.--definition: Path to a FULL model definition folder (a .SemanticModel folder or any folder with definition.pbism + definition/ TMDL files or model.bim). Gathers all files recursively — the way a real multi-file TMDL model ships. Validated first (needs definition.pbism + a model body).
flags.--one-lake-table: OneLake table URL for API-native Direct Lake creation; repeat up to 100 times. Supports default dbo and explicit schema URL forms.
flags.--connection: SQL endpoint or lakehouse ID for definition-backed Direct Lake binding. Requires --file or --definition; rejected for empty and --one-lake-table creation.

notes: Definition-backed Direct Lake uses TMDL (model.bim cannot express directLake partitions). API-native --one-lake-table creation requires no authored TMDL or definition.pbism files.
model.bim MUST use compatibilityLevel 1604 and powerBI_V3
Create a FULL multi-file TMDL model from a folder with --definition <folder> (a .SemanticModel folder); --file only sends a single file. Previously only deploy could push a full TMDL tree.
Omit --file, --definition, and --one-lake-table to create an empty semantic model. --one-lake-table uses creationPayload and is mutually exclusive with definition inputs.
After creation, call refresh to frame Direct Lake: fabio semantic-model refresh
Call takeover to make editable in portal: fabio semantic-model takeover

Definition-backed input needs definition.pbism regardless of format: include it in a --definition folder; fabio generates it for a single --file. Empty and --one-lake-table creation do not require definition files.

Introspect a model's schema WITHOUT parsing its definition via DAX INFO.VIEW.* (the Analysis Services Schema Rowsets): list-tables (StorageMode incl. Direct Lake), list-columns (DataType/SummarizeBy/FormatString), list-measures (Expression/FormatString), list-relationships (Cardinality/CrossFilteringBehavior). Use these before writing DAX or wiring a report.

Enhanced/granular refresh: 'refresh --objects '[{"table":"Sales"}]'' refreshes specific tables/partitions (TMSL refresh semantics); add --commit-mode transactional|partialBatch, --max-parallelism, --retry-count. Registers as ViaEnhancedApi. Monitor with refresh-details --refresh-id <requestId> (object-level status) and stop with cancel-refresh --refresh-id <requestId>; get the requestId from refresh-status.

Scheduled (automatic) refresh: get-refresh-schedule / update-refresh-schedule (import/Direct Lake). Times must be on the full/half hour (HH:00 or HH:30); to disable pass ONLY --enabled false (the API rejects changing other settings while disabling). DirectQuery/Live models use a different directQueryRefreshSchedule endpoint (reach via rest call --api powerbi).
